theme studio

Make a theme.

Every control termpaper has, on a live preview. Start from a built-in theme or from nothing; bring your terminal's colour scheme along as a palette.

Import a share code, a theme file, or a terminal colour scheme

Paste a tp1: code, a termpaper theme (.toml), or a colour scheme from kitty, Alacritty, Ghostty, iTerm2 or Windows Terminal. A colour scheme becomes the palette.
